nl: Merge override.json into base.json and write the result to effective.json: keys of override.json replace those of base.json, nested objects are merged key by key (case 2).
oracle_program: read "base.json" |> merge (read "override.json") deep: true |> write "effective.json" format: json
reference_bash:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
b = json.load(open('base.json'))
o = json.load(open('override.json'))
for k, v in o.items():
    if isinstance(v, dict):
        b.setdefault(k, {}).update(v)
    else:
        b[k] = v
json.dump(b, open('effective.json', 'w'), indent=2)
EOF
